candidateRule.prevention: Normalize line breaks into explicit separate text entities or safe separators before emitting the plan.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A text fixture containing CR/LF must fail before compile; sanitized rows must validate and render verbatim.
candidateRule.requirement: Native text values must be sanitized to supported single-line characters before plan validation.

lessons.correction: Replace the newline with a semicolon-separated single line and place it in a dedicated framed row.
lessons.failingCheck: aicad-agent validate SEC_NOTE text control-character gate
lessons.rootCause: The builder treated a multiline note as one native text value although the schema permits only safe single-line content.
lessons.symptom: Validation rejected SEC_NOTE because a newline was embedded in a single native text entity.

candidateRule.prevention: Classify destinations before staging: reject files and non-empty directories, but transactionally swap an empty directory through a rollback slot and restore it on promotion failure.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Apply to an existing empty TemporaryDirectory and require a complete five-artifact result, then reapply to the now non-empty directory and require rejection with byte-identical contents.
candidateRule.requirement: Atomic directory promotion must preserve established empty-output-directory compatibility without allowing overwrite of existing artifacts.

lessons.correction: Permit only an existing empty directory, move it to a temporary rollback slot, promote the complete staged payload as one directory, and restore the empty destination if promotion fails.
lessons.rootCause: The first atomic-promotion implementation treated every existing destination as unsafe instead of distinguishing an empty rollback-safe directory from a non-empty artifact directory.
lessons.symptom: A valid handoff failed because apply_review_handoff rejected the existing empty TemporaryDirectory used by the established API contract.

candidateRule.prevention: Enumerate all producer locations and all additionalProperties=false schema definitions before merging a field addition, then validate representative 2D and 3D packages.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Emit placement metadata on a 2D line entity and require the full view-package Draft 2020-12 validation to pass; remove either view_entity property and require failure.
candidateRule.requirement: A new emitted field must be closed across every strict schema object that can physically carry it.

lessons.correction: Declare the optional placement_path enum and exact two-number placement_point array on $defs.view_entity.
lessons.rootCause: The implementation and selection_ref schema were updated, but the separate strict view_entity definition was omitted from the same contract change.
lessons.symptom: Strict validation rejected placement_path and placement_point on a 2D view entity as additional properties.

candidateRule.prevention: Start a hidden 127.0.0.1 server with an explicit directory and fixed bounded port, then snapshot over HTTP.
candidateRule.regressionTest: file:// navigation must be rejected; the same page over loopback HTTP must render with zero functional console errors.
candidateRule.requirement: Automated local reviewer QA must use a loopback-only HTTP origin when file navigation is blocked.

lessons.correction: Serve the staged directory read-only on 127.0.0.1 and navigate through HTTP.
lessons.rootCause: The browser automation security policy forbids the file protocol even for a staged local reviewer.
lessons.symptom: Playwright blocked navigation to file:///C:/Users/Public/AICADReview/.../review.html.

candidateRule.prevention: Use PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 together with python -B for packaged suites and always rerun the exact package verifier after tests.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Prove a child interpreter can pollute the package when only -B is used, then prove the inherited environment prevents caches and the exact manifest/SHA verifier remains green.
candidateRule.requirement: Post-build tests executed inside a manifested package tree must disable bytecode for the complete parent/child Python process tree.

lessons.correction: Remove only the verified regenerable cache directory, set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for the entire process tree, rerun the packaged tests, and then rerun package verification.
lessons.rootCause: The packaged suite was launched with parent-interpreter -B only; child interpreters did not inherit that command-line flag and wrote __pycache__ files into the mutable assembled package.
lessons.symptom: The independent package verifier rejected 19 runtime Python bytecode cache files as cache, manifest-unlisted, and sums-unlisted contamination.

candidateRule.prevention: Treat TOOLS, tools/list, build manifest and exact inventory test as a four-surface bijection and run the handshake test before the full suite.
candidateRule.regressionTest: List tools through the MCP handshake and require exact equality including all three review-handoff tools; delete or add one name on either side and require failure.
candidateRule.requirement: Every MCP tool addition or removal must update the one exact runtime inventory contract in the same change.

lessons.correction: Add aicad_get_review_handoff_schema, aicad_validate_review_handoff and aicad_apply_review_handoff to the exact expected tool set.
lessons.rootCause: The MCP implementation and focused handoff test changed without updating the repository-wide exact tool-surface contract.
lessons.symptom: The runtime tools/list response correctly contained three new handoff tools, but the exact expected inventory rejected them as unexpected.

candidateRule.prevention: Build commands from canonical POSIX-style relative paths independent of the host shell.
candidateRule.regressionTest: The backslash form must fail; the forward-slash form must audit the merged bundle without enabling any rule.
candidateRule.requirement: Controlled-learning QA invocation must preserve the same portable path grammar as the harvester.

lessons.correction: Use forward slashes for bundle, root-relative output and optional ledger/manifest paths.
lessons.rootCause: The QA intentionally shares the portable path policy, but the invocation reused a shell-native path.
lessons.symptom: The learning QA rejected a Windows backslash bundle path as unsafe relative input.

candidateRule.prevention: Centralize or contract-test reviewer fixtures whenever the production modifier validator adds a mandatory surface.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Require the generic request fixture to pass modifier validation, launch the reviewer, and block the supplied native file with explicit_native_cad_request_required.
candidateRule.requirement: Policy tests that cross a validated artifact boundary must use the minimum complete current artifact contract, not a role-only placeholder.

lessons.correction: Replace the shared placeholder with a minimal contract-complete selectable vector reviewer while preserving strict production validation.
lessons.rootCause: The production modifier validator was strengthened, but this packaged test retained a role-only placeholder without vector geometry, source identifiers, inspection/correction surfaces, or safety locks.
lessons.symptom: The generic-open policy test errored before its native-file blocking assertion because the shared HTML placeholder did not satisfy the selectable-vector modifier contract.

candidateRule.prevention: Check every existing closure hash before merge and rebuild from immutable failure reports rather than patching derived lesson IDs.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Editing a closure-bound test must make the stale bundle fail; refreshing the source report and re-harvesting must preserve exact failure/lesson bijection.
candidateRule.requirement: A lesson bundle used as merge input must be re-harvested whenever an exact-closure source or affected artifact changes.

lessons.correction: Refresh the original failure report closures from current safe-relative files and deterministically re-harvest the report chain before merging new lessons.
lessons.rootCause: The historical report and derived candidate bundle still bound the pre-fix source hash while exact closure is evaluated against the current workspace.
lessons.symptom: The merge rejected existing lesson 9 because tests/test_modifier_ui_v2.py changed during the current corrective work.

candidateRule.prevention: Use a file inventory lookup once per workspace and cache the exact safe-relative entrypoint.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A root-relative guessed path must fail; the discovered canonical path must print capabilities and help.
candidateRule.requirement: Operational entrypoints must be resolved from the checked repository tree before invocation.

lessons.correction: Resolve CLI locations with rg --files and invoke the canonical agent-plugin script path.
lessons.rootCause: The operational command was guessed instead of resolved from the repository inventory.
lessons.symptom: The command failed because aicad_agent.py is under agent-plugin/aicad-agent/scripts, not repository root.

candidateRule.prevention: Inventory scripts once and bind the selected entrypoint hash into the release record.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Guessed names must fail; the discovered build-agent-plugin and build-github-source scripts must succeed.
candidateRule.requirement: Release commands must be resolved from the current repository and never guessed from another workspace.

lessons.correction: List the scripts directory and use build-agent-plugin.ps1 plus build-github-source.ps1.
lessons.rootCause: The release entrypoint name was inferred from prior context instead of resolved from scripts inventory.
lessons.symptom: Both package-release.ps1 and package_release.ps1 were absent.

candidateRule.prevention: Run a bounded local-page smoke after help and separate help-teardown defects from command capability.
candidateRule.regressionTest: The help command must retain the nonzero assertion evidence while a real HTTP open and snapshot must succeed.
candidateRule.requirement: Browser-tool readiness must be proven by a real open/snapshot command, not only a help-command exit code.

lessons.correction: Treat help output as capability evidence only; verify a real session command and preserve the nonzero teardown evidence.
lessons.rootCause: This Playwright CLI/runtime combination can crash during help teardown even when commands remain usable.
lessons.symptom: The CLI printed complete help but exited 1 with a Windows libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING assertion.

candidateRule.prevention: Resolve the plugin-scoped rules path before QA and include it as a safe-relative argument.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Omitting --rules at repository root must fail; the explicit agent-plugin rules path must pass without modifying the file.
candidateRule.requirement: Continuous-learning QA must bind the authoritative rules file explicitly when the evidence root is above the plugin root.

lessons.correction: Pass --rules agent-plugin/aicad-agent/rules/continuous_learning_rules.json explicitly.
lessons.rootCause: The command used --root . but omitted the plugin-scoped --rules path required by this repository layout.
lessons.symptom: QA failed because its default rules/continuous_learning_rules.json path does not exist at repository root.

candidateRule.prevention: Generate and validate the origin bootstrap and excludedEntityIds membership together, then assert the plan_geometry predicate before invoking the full prover.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A fixture with correct production bijection but no excluded origin bootstrap must fail plan_geometry; adding exactly one first origin bootstrap must pass without changing production IDs.
candidateRule.requirement: A bounded mechanical normality plan must begin with one explicit excluded global-origin bootstrap before production entities.

lessons.correction: Add ORIGIN_BOOTSTRAP as the first origin-anchored plan line and list it in excludedEntityIds without adding it to logical production geometry.
lessons.rootCause: The run-specific plan omitted the prover's additional contract that the first plan entity must be an excluded line anchored at the global origin.
lessons.symptom: The plan_geometry gate failed while its printed mapping, layer, endpoint, metadata, anchor and dimension evidence were all green.

candidateRule.prevention: Validate shared reviewer fixtures directly before using them to assert later native-host sequencing behavior.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Require the explicit request to open the selectable reviewer before the native CAD file and return the exact two-step open_order.
candidateRule.requirement: Reviewer-first sequencing tests must prove ordering with an artifact that independently passes the current reviewer contract.

lessons.correction: Use the same minimal contract-complete reviewer fixture and keep the production validator fail-closed.
lessons.rootCause: The test input was not upgraded when selectable vector geometry, source binding, measurement, correction, and safety locks became mandatory.
lessons.symptom: The explicit native-open policy test errored before its reviewer-first order assertion because the shared HTML placeholder failed the strong modifier contract.

candidateRule.prevention: Select an actual datum or centreline through origin as entity one and validate before adding the remaining sheet.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A drawing whose first entity misses origin must fail; replacing it with the real datum centreline must pass without excluded geometry.
candidateRule.requirement: A mechanical drawing must begin with meaningful origin-anchored production geometry, not a fake bootstrap.

lessons.correction: Make the upper datum-B centreline the first meaningful entity from [0,0] to [0,145].
lessons.failingCheck: aicad-agent validate first-entity origin hard gate
lessons.rootCause: The drawing builder started from an outline edge instead of the datum-B centreline segment anchored at origin.
lessons.symptom: The initial 2D plan was rejected because its first production entity did not begin at the drawing origin.

candidateRule.prevention: Publish and reuse discovery commands from the package manifest or build script.
candidateRule.regressionTest: The dotted invocation must reproduce ImportError; the equivalent discover invocation must execute the intended tests.
candidateRule.requirement: Repository test commands must match the declared discovery layout and must not assume package markers.

lessons.correction: Use unittest discover with -s tests and an explicit -p filename pattern.
lessons.rootCause: The invocation assumed dotted package modules instead of this repository's unittest discovery layout.
lessons.symptom: Focused tests failed to import because tests is not a Python package in this repository.

candidateRule.prevention: Compute cell centres from frame bounds and run a visual collision audit before final handoff.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A title/notes fixture must keep every text bounding box inside its declared frame and outside production geometry.
candidateRule.requirement: Controlled drawing text must be cell-bound, non-overlapping and traceable to explicit frame geometry.

lessons.correction: Center text in exact title cells; frame view labels, feature callouts and five general-note rows; move the section note to a free band.
lessons.failingCheck: user visual review of title block and notes
lessons.rootCause: The builder supplied edge-like insertion coordinates while the renderer uses centered text anchors, and notes lacked row geometry.
lessons.symptom: Title text was anchored around cell edges, general notes were unframed and the first section-note frame overlapped the section geometry.

candidateRule.prevention: Render each mechanical layer token with an explicit style and cover hidden and centre dash patterns in tests.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A fixture containing all mechanical layers must show unique computed stroke width or dash style per role.
candidateRule.requirement: Mechanical review views must preserve visible hierarchy across standard semantic line classes.

lessons.correction: Add distinct width, colour and dash patterns for OUTLINE, HOLE, HIDDEN, CENTER, DIMENSION, HATCH and TITLE.
lessons.failingCheck: user visual review of mechanical 2D drawing
lessons.rootCause: The reviewer had semantic lineweights for architecture layers but no mechanical layer-specific styles.
lessons.symptom: Outline, hole, hidden, centre, dimension, hatch and title geometry appeared nearly identical.

candidateRule.prevention: Resolve and compare the output path before build, requiring releaseRoot plus a directory separator prefix.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Output equal to release root must fail; release/v1.16.0 must pass and atomically publish.
candidateRule.requirement: Release output must be a version-scoped descendant of the protected release root.

lessons.correction: Use release/v1.16.0 so transactional stage and backup paths remain bounded below release.
lessons.rootCause: The command supplied the protected release root rather than a version-scoped child directory.
lessons.symptom: Using OutputDirectory=release was rejected because output must be a child of release, not the boundary itself.

candidateRule.prevention: Assert the harvester exit code and output existence before constructing the QA command.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A forced harvest failure must skip QA; a successful harvest must produce the exact bundle consumed by QA.
candidateRule.requirement: Dependent learning QA must be short-circuited when lesson harvesting fails or produces no bundle.

lessons.correction: Invoke QA only after the candidate bundle exists and the harvester exits zero.
lessons.rootCause: The sequential orchestration collected both results without gating QA execution on the required harvester success status.
lessons.symptom: QA ran after the harvester failed and reported the derived candidate bundle missing.

candidateRule.prevention: For multi-gate workflows, validate prerequisites independently and bind the test fixture to the current upstream contract.
candidateRule.regressionTest: With a valid selectable reviewer, require an explicitly requested PDF target to fail with rejects non-CAD artifacts.
candidateRule.requirement: A negative policy test must keep all prerequisite artifacts valid so the asserted gate is the first and only intended failure.

lessons.correction: Upgrade the reviewer fixture so the test reaches and verifies the explicit native-target suffix gate.
lessons.rootCause: A stale shared fixture introduced an unrelated earlier failure and masked the policy boundary the test was designed to exercise.
lessons.symptom: The PDF suffix assertion failed because the invalid placeholder reviewer triggered the strong modifier error before the intended non-CAD target diagnostic.

candidateRule.prevention: For a non-package test directory, use unittest discovery with an explicit start directory and exact filename pattern; never synthesize dotted tests.* imports.
candidateRule.regressionTest: In a fixture whose tests directory has no __init__.py, require dotted import startup to fail and exact-pattern discovery to execute the intended module successfully.
candidateRule.requirement: Focused Python test launchers must select an invocation mode that matches whether the test root is a package.

lessons.correction: Invoke the test through unittest discovery with -s tests and the exact test_universal.py filename pattern.
lessons.rootCause: The tests directory is intentionally not a Python package, but the launcher used a dotted package module name.
lessons.symptom: The focused command failed before discovery with ModuleNotFoundError for tests.test_universal.

candidateRule.prevention: Create explicit width, height, X and Y constraints and assert status 3 before feature creation.
candidateRule.regressionTest: A negative-X rectangle fixture must save/reopen fully constrained with zero feature error codes.
candidateRule.requirement: Every native rectangle must receive deterministic size and position constraints before automatic full definition.

lessons.correction: Add explicit rectangle width, height and lower-left X/Y dimensions or zero relations before FullyDefineSketch.
lessons.rootCause: FullyDefineSketch did not deterministically constrain lower-left placement for all negative-offset rectangles.
lessons.symptom: The first native build stopped at negative-X rectangle F004 with sketch status 2 and two underdefined points.

candidateRule.prevention: Run proprietary-binary scanning before promotion and provide an explicit source-only fallback build.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Including the three binaries must fail; source-only packaging must pass with identical public capabilities and build instructions.
candidateRule.requirement: Public plugin packages must exclude proprietary CAD interop binaries while retaining reproducible source integration.

lessons.correction: Publish audited host source and build script only; keep locally built binaries outside the public package.
lessons.rootCause: Public source release policy forbids redistributing proprietary or prebuilt host binaries.
lessons.symptom: The IncludeSolidWorksInterop build was rejected for the host executable and two SolidWorks interop DLLs.

candidateRule.prevention: Validate generated HTML with validate_interactive_modifier_contract in the renderer regression suite.
candidateRule.regressionTest: Both 2D and 3D single-document pages must satisfy the strong opener contract and reject raster-only wrappers.
candidateRule.requirement: Renderer and reviewer-first opener must share one mandatory modifier identity contract for every document mode.

lessons.correction: Emit single_document modifier mode, role and document-scoped selection attributes on every non-document-set reviewer.
lessons.rootCause: The renderer emitted the role only for multi-storey document sets, while the opener required it for every reviewer.
lessons.symptom: The generated mechanical reviewers were rejected for missing interactive_drawing_modifier role.

candidateRule.prevention: For a non-package test directory, use unittest discovery with an explicit start directory and exact filename pattern; never synthesize dotted tests.* imports.
candidateRule.regressionTest: In a fixture whose tests directory has no __init__.py, require dotted import startup to fail and exact-pattern discovery to execute the intended module successfully.
candidateRule.requirement: Focused Python test launchers must select an invocation mode that matches whether the test root is a package.

lessons.correction: Invoke the test through unittest discovery with -s tests and the exact test_modifier_ui_v2.py filename pattern.
lessons.rootCause: The tests directory is intentionally not a Python package, but the launcher used a dotted package module name.
lessons.symptom: The focused command failed before discovery with ModuleNotFoundError for tests.test_modifier_ui_v2.

candidateRule.prevention: Normalize separators before invocation and reject drive-qualified, parent-traversal and backslash forms.
candidateRule.regressionTest: The backslash form must fail; the forward-slash equivalent must harvest with exact bidirectional closure.
candidateRule.requirement: Controlled-learning CLI paths must use portable forward-slash safe-relative syntax on every platform.

lessons.correction: Pass every report, existing bundle and output path with forward slashes.
lessons.rootCause: The command used shell-native backslashes although the learning contract requires portable forward-slash paths.
lessons.symptom: The harvester rejected a Windows backslash path as unsafe relative input.

candidateRule.prevention: For a non-package test directory, use unittest discovery with an explicit start directory and exact filename pattern; never synthesize dotted tests.* imports.
candidateRule.regressionTest: In a fixture whose tests directory has no __init__.py, require dotted import startup to fail and exact-pattern discovery to execute the intended module successfully.
candidateRule.requirement: Focused Python test launchers must select an invocation mode that matches whether the test root is a package.

lessons.correction: Invoke the test through unittest discovery with -s tests and the exact test_review_handoff.py filename pattern.
lessons.rootCause: The tests directory is intentionally not a Python package, but the launcher used a dotted package module name.
lessons.symptom: The focused command failed before discovery with ModuleNotFoundError for tests.test_review_handoff.

candidateRule.prevention: Derive display height from drawing domain and assert generated mechanical HTML never contains font-size 280.
candidateRule.regressionTest: The same dimension fixture must keep 280 for architecture and use 4 for mechanical with no geometry occlusion.
candidateRule.requirement: Dimension annotation scale must be domain appropriate and visually bounded by the sheet extent.

lessons.correction: Use 280 only for architecture and 4 for mechanical/generic drawings; add a full-sheet 2D card layout.
lessons.rootCause: The 2D view mapper hard-coded the architecture millimetre text height for every domain.
lessons.symptom: Dimension labels rendered at font-size 280 and obscured nearly all geometry.
